failure_modes.mechanism: Likely caused by thermal or electrical faults leading to ignition of materials, possibly due to overheating or arc faults.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: One severe incident on 2024-07-05 resulted in a cost of EUR 48714 and 99.2 hours of downtime. The incident is indicative, with weather conditions nominales, and the failure is under-represented compared to site incidents.

failure_modes.mechanism: Corrosion, insulation deterioration, or mechanical damage causing short circuits and degradation in wiring.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: Two incidents, one severe on 2025-06-20 and one moderate on 2025-07-14, with a total cost of EUR 36150 and 80.4 hours of downtime. The first incident was under moderate weather conditions, with a recurrence within 90 days.

failure_modes.mechanism: Electrical faults or overheating in the support structure leading to fire, possibly due to insulation failure or component malfunction.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: One severe incident on 2023-08-06 caused EUR 34465 in damages and 60.7 hours of downtime. Weather was clear, and the incident is in line with site data.

failure_modes.mechanism: Impact from hail, wind-driven debris, or mechanical stress causing superficial damage to PV modules.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: Five incidents with no severe cases, total EUR 26364, and 73.6 hours of downtime. The dominant weather was hail or storm conditions, with some incidents occurring under stormy weather.

failure_modes.mechanism: Electrical failure or corrosion within junction boxes and string components, possibly exacerbated by environmental exposure.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: Two severe incidents, one on 2023-02-28 and another on 2023-10-15, totaling EUR 25010 and 46.9 hours of downtime. Weather was nominal or clear, with incidents over a long period.

failure_modes.mechanism: Degradation or wear of connectors over time, leading to increased resistance or failure, mitigated by preventive replacement.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: Three incidents, all moderate, with total EUR 15573 and 44.7 hours of downtime. Weather conditions varied, including clear, calm, and moderate wind.

failure_modes.mechanism: Accumulation of dirt, dust, or debris reducing module efficiency, addressed by cleaning.
failure_modes.evidence_and_impact: One moderate incident on 2025-02-28, EUR 6080 in cost, and 18.5 hours of downtime, under nominal weather conditions.
